subQuestions.questionText: A farm animal ingested 18 kg of hay, with a dry matter content of 90% and excreted 5 kg dry manure. Calculate the digestibility co-efficient of the ingested hay. Show ALL calculations.
subQuestions.memoText:
Mark 1: DMI (kg) = (90 × 18) / 100 = 16,2 kg ✓
Mark 2: Formula: DC = [(DMI − dry mass of manure) / DMI] × 100 ✓
Mark 3: Substitution: = [(16,2 − 5) / 16,2] × 100 ✓
Mark 4: Answer: 69,1 ✓
Mark 5: Unit: % ✓
Final answer: $DC = 69{,}1\%$

subQuestions.questionText: Define the term nutritive ratio.
subQuestions.memoText: NR is the ratio between the digestible protein ✓ (1 mark) and digestible non-nitrogen compounds in a ration or a feed ✓ (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: A feed contains 7% digestible protein and the total digestible nutrients is 79%. Use the formula to calculate the nutritive ratio of the feed. Show ALL calculations.
subQuestions.memoText:
Mark 1: Formula: $NR = 1 : \frac{\%TDN - \%DP}{\%DP}$ ✓
Mark 2: Substitution: $= 1 : \frac{79\% - 7\%}{7\%}$ ✓
Mark 3: Answer: $NR = 1:10$ ✓

OR

Mark 1: Formula: $NR = 1 : \frac{\%\text{digestible non-nitrogen nutrients}}{\%\text{Digestible protein}}$ ✓
Mark 2: Substitution: $= 1 : \frac{72\%}{7\%}$ ✓
Mark 3: Answer: $NR = 1:10$ ✓
